cases.title: Houde v. Deputy Head (Correctional Service of Canada)
cases.summary: The Board denied a grievance challenging an eight-day suspension after a correctional manager used unnecessary and disproportionate force while working an overtime correctional officer shift. The result turned on discipline proportionality, use-of-force seriousness, remorse, prior record, experience, and aggravating/mitigating factors.
